title: Transit trip cards are mock routes labeled as live GTFS
problem: `getLiveTransitData` injects `generateRoutes()` from mock data and still marks provenance `confidence: high`. Origin is always the mock Milwaukee Holton St address. Hide trip cards until OTP/Mapbox is wired, or label them as sample schedules and drop mock imports from the live path.

title: Admin APIs are public when ADMIN_SECRET is unset
problem: `isAuthorized` returns true if `ADMIN_SECRET` is missing. `/admin` pages have no middleware. Fail closed in production (401) and protect `/admin/*`.

title: Anyone can POST /api/sources and refresh every upstream feed
problem: Public POST plus client auto-refresh after 8s (`use-source-sync`) can DoS BLS, QCEW×72, GTFS, and job APIs. Require admin/cron auth and a global refresh mutex.

title: Live economy still built from 10 featured counties, not 72
problem: `WI_COUNTIES` and `getLiveEconomyData` only cover 10 metros. Explore cards, QCEW fetches, and county-panel extra tiles miss the rest of Wisconsin. Iterate all FIPS in `WI_COUNTY_NAME_TO_FIPS`.

title: Budgets and Insights pages serve unlabeled mock data
problem: Both pages read adapters backed by `src/data/mock` with HTTP 200 APIs and no sample-data banner. Add a prominent mock banner or replace with live sources. Download/Share on Insights are dead buttons.

title: Unknown location still silently becomes Milwaukee
problem: `/api/location`, `/api/news`, job geocodes, saved-place coords, and invalid county ids fall back to Milwaukee. Return `resolved: false` / null coords instead of pretending the user is in Milwaukee.

title: Registry lists 7 agencies; live fetch defaults to MCTS + Madison
problem: `agency=all` and agent `getTransitSnapshot` still load Milwaukee/Madison only. Map transit panel maps `all` → `mcts`. Green Bay GTFS URL looks like an HTML DocumentCenter page, not a zip. Fetch all registry agencies (or bbox-filter) and validate zip responses.

title: Job commute estimates only use MCTS and Madison stops
problem: Statewide jobs get bogus transit flags. `transitAccessible` is hardcoded true for Milwaukee/Madison city names. Select agency via `agencyByCounty` and default transitAccessible to false until enrichment runs.

title: USAJobs/Adzuna errors are cached for 30 minutes
problem: 401/429/network failures stick in the in-memory cache. Only cache successful payloads; use a short TTL for errors.

title: County cost of living, population change, and transit coverage are hardcoded
problem: `costOfLivingIndex: 95`, `populationChange: 0.5`, and transit coverage constants are presented as live. Missing WisConomy rows become 3.5% unemployment. Omit or mark estimated; never invent rates.

title: One BLS/WisConomy failure 502s the whole economy payload
problem: Use `Promise.allSettled` and return partial counties with source error flags. WisConomy XLS layout changes currently take down unemployment statewide.

title: Agent POST is unauthenticated and unbounded
problem: Anyone can stream LLM + tool calls. Malformed JSON 500s. Add IP rate limits, 400 on bad JSON, and debounce `refreshStaleSources`.

title: Prisma SavedJob/SavedPlace models are unused; saved places stay in localStorage
problem: Schema and postinstall generate imply a database that is never queried. Wire saved places or remove Prisma until needed. Experiments are in-memory and reset on deploy.

title: In-memory cache has no LRU cap; GTFS bbox keys grow forever
problem: Add max entries and sweep expired keys. Normalize GTFS bbox to a grid so panning does not explode keys.

title: Saved places always store Milwaukee downtown coordinates
problem: Address text is ignored. `/transit?job=` from saved jobs is unread on the transit page. Geocode addresses and handle the job query param (or link to /jobs).

title: Map home forces a light basemap and light-only dock chrome
problem: `forceLightBasemap` plus hardcoded `bg-white` on MapChatWidget/logo/carousel. No theme toggle on `/` because Header is hidden. Respect darkMode or document always-light map as intentional.

title: WorkwaysAgentPanel and WorkspaceChrome are unused duplicates
problem: 490-line chat panel and workspace chrome never import. AgentShell `isOpen` is unused. Delete or wire a single agent surface.

title: Explore layer toggles only recolor 10 dots, not a choropleth
problem: Copy says live county markers. Wire `/api/economy/map` choropleth or drop the misleading toggles. Default compare is Milwaukee vs Dane.

title: Agent drawTransitRoute draws a straight line, not a GTFS path
problem: System prompt still says transit is MCTS/Madison only. Update tools + prompt for all registered agencies, or label the line as an approximate corridor.

title: Trip planner shows mock RouteCards while copy says router coming soon
problem: UI admits router is unwired but still renders full trip cards from generateRoutes mock data.

title: Desktop transit sheet hides service alerts
problem: Desktop TransitDetailSheet receives alerts={[]} while mobile gets real alerts.

title: Job cards always say commute is by transit
problem: Copy ignores commute.mode when enrichment used a drive estimate.

title: Jobs page has no location filter
problem: Keyword/industry/commute only; cannot search outside implicit API defaults. Mobile sheet missing safe-area.

title: News API defaults to Milwaukee
problem: Missing county/lat/lng silently uses DEFAULT_USER_AREA.

title: Default chat starters are Milwaukee/Madison
problem: Fallback chips mention Milwaukee jobs and fly to Madison when location prompts are off.

title: Area picker only lists 10 featured counties
problem: Manual picker should use all 72 counties with search.

title: Source panel hardcodes two GTFS agencies
problem: Does not generate chips from TRANSIT_AGENCY_LIST.

title: Site meta claims Prisma stores experiments
problem: Experiments are in-memory; Prisma is unused.

title: Privacy copy says OpenFreeMap is the default basemap
problem: Maps default to CARTO/Esri rasters unless Mapbox token is set.

title: Client may send IP to ipapi.co
problem: Third-party IP geolocation without going through first-party /api/location.
